method: Node zlib.gzipSync(buffer) with default options; one gzip stream per served file, then sums; no build or server started.

figureRuntime.note: FigureRuntime entry and reachable imports, independently summed per file with the same gzip method. The shared main chunk may expand this closure to the full application graph.

javascript.parserNote: Counts only relative/public local .js static and literal dynamic imports reachable from the HTML module entry. URL/data/blob/external imports are omitted.

css.note: All built CSS files, including lazy CSS chunks, measured separately from JavaScript.

nativeAndRuntime.note: WASM/data/Python/archive payloads measured separately; informational and excluded from JS/CSS budgets.
